signatures.description: Steals private information from local Internet browsers

T1003.long: Credential dumping is the process of obtaining account login and password information, normally in the form of a hash or a clear text password, from the operating system and software. Credentials can then be used to perform Lateral Movement and access restricted information.

T1081.long: Adversaries may search local file systems and remote file shares for files containing passwords. These can be files created by users to store their own credentials, shared credential stores for a group of individuals, configuration files containing passwords for a system or service, or source code/binary files containing embedded passwords.

T1005.long: Sensitive data can be collected from local system sources, such as the file system or databases of information residing on the system prior to Exfiltration.
